text: {"assertions":["A plan drift issue was discovered in infra/terraform/vpc.tf on 2026-01-07.","The plan drift occurred when the input list parameter was empty.","The root cause of the plan drift was connection pool exhaustion under burst load.","The plan drift produced spurious diffs on resources that had not been edited.","The issue resulted in 82 duplicate rows being written to the database daily.","The fix involved raising the connection pool ceiling and adding a bounded wait queue.","The fix was implemented in PR #1789 on the fix/plan-drift-1 branch.","The problematic code was in the same area of infra/terraform/vpc.tf as previous plan drift work."]}
